data.one_liner: Extended Mustache template processor for Dart with variable recasing and missing variable handling.
data.what_it_does: Processes Mustache templates with added support for variable recasing, missing variable fulfillment functions, and automatic hasFoo guards. It ports and extends previous mustache and mustache_template packages.
use_when: You need to render text templates using Mustache syntax in Dart or Flutter.
You need automatic variable recasing such as snake_case or pascalCase inside templates.
You need custom fallback handlers for missing variables during template rendering.
avoid_when: You require complex logic processing that goes beyond template string replacement.
You are already heavily invested in alternative parsing libraries like xml or yaml.
strengths: Supports multiple variable recasing formats out of the box.
Includes helpful hasFoo guard checks for various types of values.
weaknesses: Depends on a fork of older unmaintained packages ported into the repository.
Limited to template processing use cases.
